- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. ### ① Derived judgments

Every accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, judged against each handler's ACTUAL read points at this head (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`), every helper that takes `req` or `req.query` included.

1. **`PUT /meta/:type/:name` = `force`, `package`, `mode` — right.** Reads: `req.query?.force` (`:7185`), `metaItemPackageBinding(req.query?.package)` (`:7194`), and `mode` a frame down in `metaSaveRequestOptions` (`meta-save-request.ts:118`, that module's only query read). `resolveExecCtx` / `computeExecCtx`, `walledCatalogRefusal`, `resolveProtocol` / `resolveRequestEnvironmentId` (route, hostname, `X-Environment-Id` header) and `resolveMetaWriteActor` read no query key, and no token-in-query auth read exists anywhere in the file. 3. **`/layers` = `package` — right.** Read a frame down in `serveMetaItemLayered` (`:4083`). `resolveObjectMasker` reads the session; `createMetaLayeredAnswer` takes `MetaItemReadGateSources` (`resolveCaller`, `resolveSecurityService`, `listMetaItems`, `serviceProbe`, `navPruneLogged`), which carries no `requestLocale`, and the layered view is "not translated and not cached" by design — so `locale` is correctly NOT in this set.
4. **`/audit` = `limit` — right.** `readDeclaredQueryNumber(req.query, 'limit', …)` (`:7663`); `refuseNonAuthoringCaller`, `eventDoorRefusal`, `fetchCurrentMetaDocument` and `metaItemReadGate` read the session and the store, no query.
5. **`/diff` = `from`, `fromVersion`, `to`, `toVersion` — right.** Both spellings are read (`:8097`-`:8102`); the mask posture, the current-document fetch and the gate read no query.
6. **`/published` = empty — right.** `resolveObjectMasker`, `resolveProtocol`, `getMetaItemLayered({ type, name })`, `metaItemReadGate`, `resolveMetadataService` and `getPublished(type, name)` read no query key.
7. **Where each refusal sits — right, and it matches the ruled doors.** `PUT`: after the capability 403, the walled-catalog 403 and the 501, before `resolveMetaWriteActor` and `saveMetaItem` (the DELETE / publish / rollback precedent) — nothing is written, and nothing a prior gate refuses is leaked. `/audit` and `/diff`: after `refuseNonAuthoringCaller` and the 501, before the per-caller gate and any read (the `/history` precedent). `/references`, `/layers`, `/published`: first statement, before the protocol, the masker and the read gate (the ruled item GET's placement). The refusal body is static — the unknown name and the set — so none of the six becomes an existence or capability oracle. Recognition precedes each door's `refuseRepeatedQueryParams`, both in the nested `VALIDATION_ERROR` envelope: no new dialect.
8. **Caller census — holds, spot-checked.** SDK (`packages/client/src/index.ts`): `metaSaveQuery` emits only `force`, `package`, `mode` (`:787`-`:800`); `getAudit` `limit` (`:2170`); `diffItem` `from`, `to` (`:2232`-`:2233`); `getReferences` / `getPublished` send nothing; the SDK has no `/layers` caller. objectui at `1fb1ced36243`, `packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`: `save` `force` / `mode` / `package` (`:1228`-`:1230`), `layered` `package` (`:1461`), `references` nothing (`:1602`), `diff` `from` / `to` (`:1732`-`:1733`), `audit` `limit` (`:1774`), no `/published` caller; the two direct `fetch` PUTs (`preview/UnpublishedAppBar.tsx:89`, `metadata-admin/external/api.ts:247`) carry no query; `preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx:202` is the item GET (`state`, `package`), not one of these doors. In-repo: every dogfood `PUT` with a query sends `package`, `mode` or `force`; `client.test.ts` sends `audit?limit=20` and `diff?from=2&to=5`; the `?include=`, `?packageId=` and `&severity=` spellings in the tree are on `/meta/doc`, `/meta/_drafts` and `/meta/diagnostics`. CI's six `Test Core` shards and the dogfood gate are green on this head, which answers the rest and runtime suites in full.
9. **The split census test — the security property is kept and made loud.** The body case still pins that `organization_id` / `organizationId` in the body never reach `saveMetaItem` (`200`, the key absent — the request is built from named `req` values, never a body spread). The query case now pins the located `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `saveMetaItem` never called, which is stronger than watching the name get dropped. Nothing the old case asserted is unasserted now.
10. **`unknownQueryParamMessage` — right.** The subject sentence and the middle clause are untouched; for a non-empty set the tail is the same `Supported parameters: a, b.` template, byte for byte; only `supported.length === 0` takes the new sentence. The three existing pins of the message are not in the diff. These are the first empty sets in the repo, so the old `Supported parameters: .` had no prior reader to break.

The repo's grammar for exactly that is the direction arm. `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`: "`no (narrowing)` — NOT a widening, but breaking. This is the whole point of the arm." Remedy for the next head — `.changeset/23072-meta-doors-closed-sets.md`, plus the PR body's line 2: `'@objectstack/rest': minor`; `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`; exactly one ADR-0087 disposition marker in the body, in the HTML-comment form the #20139 / #20534 entries carry (`adr-0087: CATEGORY reason`; `pnpm check:adr-0087-registration` prints the category set when it fails — the import-door precedent's `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` fits a change that removes no authorable key, export or stored shape).
